exposure: Gestational age at delivery (37-40 vs. ≥41 weeks)
cohort: All term (≥37 weeks gestation), normal weight (≥2500 grams), singleton, nonanomalous births from 2009-2013 in the United States
finding: In addition to the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists' listed contraindications for planned home birth, this study found first-time births and a gestational age of ≥41 weeks to also be associated with significantly increased neonatal mortality rates.
